data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 2 x 40HC, Roasted Coffee
data.body:
Dear Maria Jansen,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer for your shipment below.

Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
Container: 2 x 40HC
Commodity: roasted coffee (palletised)

All-in total: EUR 6930

This all-in total covers both containers and includes the following:
- Base freight: EUR 2550 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- THC Rotterdam: EUR 225 per container
- THC New York: EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs: EUR 45 per shipment

Validity: this quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

If you would like to go ahead, please reply to confirm and send your expected cargo ready date. We will then arrange the booking. We are also happy to answer any questions about this offer.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
